description: Pin or save captured requests as retained records, or remove records and clear lists. Bodies may be truncated or omitted by storage budgets. Records are kept separately from the live list; availability after restart depends on successful device persistence. Get request IDs from get_network_requests. remove uses a retained-record key from flagged results. An action acknowledgement does not confirm a durable storage write.

action.description: pin/unpin/save/unsave act on one request by `id`. remove drops one kept record by `key`. clearPinned/clearSaved drop all of that kind. clearRequests wipes the live capture list (kept requests survive).

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

id.description: Request id for pin/unpin/save/unsave — from get_network_requests.

name: network_action
